definitions: An American lawyer, businessman, and politician who served as the 107th Mayor of New York City from 1994 to 2001.
A controversial figure in American politics, known for his role in the September 11th attacks response and later as a personal attorney for Donald Trump.
examples: Rudolf Giuliani was praised for his leadership after 9/11.
The legal team included Rudolf Giuliani.
Many remember Rudolf Giuliani as New York City's mayor.
